US/farm-coast.name: Farm Coast
US/farm-coast.notes: A name used locally for the coastal farming towns on both sides of the Rhode Island and Massachusetts line. It crosses a state border, which is why it is filed directly under the country. Dartmouth, MA is usually included and is not yet in the registry.

sources.name: Little Compton Town Calendar

endpoints.note: calendar.google.com's robots.txt disallows all paths for all agents, so automated fetching of this address is blocked, and the tools skip it. Open it in a browser yourself.

access.restrictions: Events live only in the embedded Google Calendar. calendar.google.com robots.txt disallows everything except the home page, which covers both the embed and the public ICS (checked 2026-11-24). The town site's own robots.txt returns 404, but calendar.php has no events in its HTML.

provenance.evidence: Found and loaded by a research agent on 2026-11-24, then re-loaded with this project's own tools.

sources.notes: Calendar page embeds the town's public Google Calendar; its ICS is the only machine-readable feed the town site offers, and robots.txt blocks it (see access.restrictions), so agents cannot read this calendar. Official meetings are also posted to RI Open Meetings; use us-ri-little-compton-open-meetings-all-bodies for those. Community events that appear only on this calendar need a person to open it.
